content: GOAL: orient before proposing. Read: working dir listing plus repository root for the RQ-VAE SID pipeline. OBSERVED: starting exploration. OPEN: which quantizer/training code is the baseline, what hyperbolic code already exists, what behaviour signals are computed.

GOAL: produce the single ideation proposal. READ: only the task prompt and the prior-round summary were available (repo files and the round directories are outside the sandbox; read/glob on them returned permission denied). OBSERVED: prior failures were cocond Sinkhorn, Frechet codebook, per-level prefix-hit curvature killed by a cap, Lorentz smoothing, cone, boost-shift. OPEN: nothing.

FINAL ANSWER: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ - per-item successor-branching curvature applied as a Mobius residual chain in the RQ-VAE quantizer. Behaviour: H_i = normalised entropy of item i's training-only next-item transition distribution (n_i>=2; else global mean). Curvature c_i = c_max*(1-H_i)+c_floor, c_max = 1/median(||z_hat_1||^2) measured on epoch-1 training encoder outputs, c_floor=1e-3; range [1e-3,c_max], no clip, because exp_0^c maps any v strictly inside the ball of radius 1/sqrt(c). Pathway: q_l=exp_0^{c_i}(r_l/M_l), p_{l,k}=exp_0^{c_i}(e_{l,k}/M_l), k_l=argmin d_P^{c_i}(q_l,p_{l,k}), r_{l+1}=log_0^{c_i}(q_l (+)_{c_i} (-p_{l,k_l})). Behaviour-off: c_i=c_max for all. Geometry-off: c_i=0 (identity/addition/Euclidean RQ). Both-on: per-item c_i. Cost B*L*K exp maps per step (~2.6e5 at B=256,L=4,K=256,d=64, ~0.2 GFLOP, <2% step). Observables: SID reassignment concentrated on extreme-H items, realised H/c deciles, prefix conditional entropy, Stage3 test_recall@10>0.065. Full formatted answer printed in the response.

STAGE: design-check for ideation_3 round 2 (single new idea, distinct from my previous submission and from CURVCTRL-SID / cocond-markov-poincare-ot / poincare-frechet-successor-codebook / BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS / MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ / SUCC-GEO-CBTAB / LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ / behcone-prefix-rq / succboost-geoshift).
GOAL: pick a coupling position that the earlier rounds did not occupy and that cannot suffer the CURVCTRL-SID saturation defect.
READ: the round brief plus the defect note on CURVCTRL-SID (per-level hard prefix hit rate -> c_l = (1/Q_l - 1)/(rho_l^2+eps), cap 0.99/max|z|^2 binds for all Q_l < ~0.95, so curvature became constant).
OBSERVED (reasoning): the saturated families are (a) curvature/weight/temperature derived from a behaviour statistic, (b) behaviour mass injected into the assignment (Sinkhorn/OT), (c) successor-weighted codebook barycentre updates, (d) behaviour cones, (e) inference-time beam rerankers. Unoccupied: the residual CHAIN itself, i.e. the transport that carries the level-l residual from the chosen centroid to the next level's domain. In a curved space parallel transport is path dependent (holonomy), and the path can be chosen by training-only behaviour. Removing curvature makes transport path independent, so behaviour becomes inert: the two factors are forced to be load bearing in one expression with no protective bound anywhere.
DECISION: submit HOLOSUCC-RQ. Curvature fixed at c=1 (canonical curvature normalisation of the hyperboloid, no tuning, no cap needed because the encoder output is normalised by the measured per-epoch max|z| before exp_0^c, per the amended rule z_hat = z/max|z|). Behaviour enters as a waypoint w_{i,l} = exp_0^c(sum_j pi_ij log_0^c q_{l,k_l(j)}) in the transport path q -> w -> 0. Effect size is the holonomy rotation theta = c * Area(triangle), continuous in w, no saturation.
OPEN: numerical stability of exp/log/PT near the ball boundary; staleness of the per-epoch waypoint table; whether code churn at levels 2..L translates into Stage3 recall.
